messages:
James: Hey — trying to pull up the ingest pipeline observability for EU but I can't find the dashboard link. Grafana just shows "You do not have access". Anyone know the canonical link or the group I should be in? :eyes:
Maria: Try this one: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/ingest/ingest-pipeline-eu?orgId=1
Maria: You need the 'observability-viewer' role or membership in the Okta group `redwood-grafana-readonly-eu` to view metrics/traces.
Leo: I hit the same thing earlier — can someone add me? @Ana
Ana: @Leo opened INFRA-1234 on your behalf just now. You can also self-request via Okta: https://okta.redwood.company/app/UserHome or run the internal /request-access flow.
Ana: I created a shortlink for the team: https://rwd.link/ingest-eu :thumbsup:
James: Thanks! One more Q — where are Loki logs for the ingest router? Any quick query I can run to check error spikes?
Maria: Loki quick query you can paste into Explore: ```{job="ingest-router", region="eu"} |= "ERROR" | count_over_time(5m)```
Maria: For traces use Jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.company/search?service=ingest-router&tags=region:eu
Leo: Request came through, I got the Okta invite and can see the Grafana dashboard now.
James: Confirmed I can view the dashboard too.
Ana: Quick note on alerts — if these error spikes are noisy please file INFRA-ALERTS with a sample log snippet and the query you used. We can either tune the threshold or add a rate-limited sentinel.
James: Will file if it continues. Thanks for the fast responses :raised_hands:
Leo: All good from my side, closing the loop.
